Policy: full-time employees max is write, with admin allowed only when their role owns the system. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so his maximum is admin. reason: Andrew Mann (E014) requested write access to Payroll. There is conflicting evidence on his employment type: HR/IT/Finance/Compliance/Facilities notes report him as full_time Payroll Specialist, but the Security DB check reports he is a contractor with basic security training, explicitly contradicting the other notes. Under the contractor policy, a contractor with only basic training may have at most read (write requires advanced security training; admin is never allowed). Since the requested write exceeds his maximum of read under the more restrictive (and security-verified) classification, and granting access must not exceed the policy maximum, I grant read.
